item.title: Trump agrees to suspend attacks for two weeks if Iran opens Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: Amid threats to bomb civilian infrastructure, the president said he had received a 10-point proposal from Iran that formed a “workable basis” for continued negotiations.

item.title: Trump threats against civilian targets put military in legal, moral quandary
item.summary: President Donald Trump said the United States would target “every” Iranian bridge and power plant. Experts say such blanket action violates international law.

item.title: Pope Leo denounces Trump’s threat to destroy Iran’s ‘whole civilization’
item.summary: The Chicago-born pope suggested fellow Americans call their congressional representatives and ask for peace, not war.

item.title: JD Vance campaigns for far-right nationalist Viktor Orban in Hungary
item.summary: The vice president traveled to Budapest as Trump’s deadline for an Iran deal loomed Tuesday, backing the administration’s closest ideological ally in Europe.

item.title: Hegseth’s boastful claims about Iran war contradict reality, officials say
item.summary: The defense secretary’s rosy portrayal of U.S. success in the conflict risks misinforming the public and the president, observers worry.

item.title: Iranian civilians voice fear and fatigue as U.S. escalates conflict
item.summary: People in Iran say they could be left to pick up the pieces if President Donald Trump destroys the country’s infrastructure and economy.

item.title: Iran war hits supply chains for K-beauty, ramen and clothes
item.summary: Even potato chips aren’t safe from the ripple effects of President Donald Trump’s war, which is disrupting supply chains across Asia.

item.title: Trump claims ‘active’ peace talks with Iran as bombing deadline approaches
item.summary: The president has given Iranian officials until 8 p.m. Tuesday to make a ceasefire deal or face widespread destruction. Tehran on Monday reasserted its rejection of U.S. demands.

item.title: U.S. designates kidnapped journalist Shelly Kittleson as a hostage
item.summary: U.S. and Iraqi officials say they believe freelancer Shelly Kittleson was kidnapped last week by Kataib Hezbollah, a paramilitary group with links to Iran.

item.title: Trump threatens to attack bridges, power plants as deadline for Iran deal nears
item.summary: The president vowed anew to destroy Iranian bridges and energy sites if a deal to open the Strait of Hormuz isn’t reached.
